<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex">
<title>Page not found — Urban Dictionary</title>
<style>
:root{--ude-bg:#fff;--ude-ink:#0B0E14;--ude-soft:#5B6270;--ude-accent:#0B0E14}
[data-udh-theme="dark"]{--ude-bg:#0E1219;--ude-ink:#EDEFF3;--ude-soft:#9AA2B2;--ude-accent:#EDEFF3}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){html:not([data-udh-theme="light"]){--ude-bg:#0E1219;--ude-ink:#EDEFF3;--ude-soft:#9AA2B2;--ude-accent:#EDEFF3}}
html,body{margin:0}
body{background:var(--ude-bg);color:var(--ude-ink);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.ude{min-height:62vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:64px 20px}
.ude__card{max-width:520px;text-align:center}
.ude__brand{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em;margin:0 0 28px;color:var(--ude-ink)}
.ude__prop{font-weight:600;color:var(--ude-soft)}
.ude__mark{width:64px;height:64px;margin:0 auto 24px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:34px;font-weight:800;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ude-ink) 7%,transparent);color:var(--ude-soft)}
.ude__title{font-size:30px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:800;margin:0 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.ude__msg{font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ude-soft);margin:0 0 28px}
.ude__btn{appearance:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;display:inline-block;font:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--ude-accent);color:var(--ude-bg);text-decoration:none;transition:opacity .15s}
.ude__btn:hover{opacity:.88}
.ude__btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ude-accent);outline-offset:3px}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ude__btn{transition:none}}</style>
